newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde June 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde June 9.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Prime Minister Lionel Jospin is said to want the European budgetary stability pact to give equal importance to economic growth and employment as to budget austerity.
-- European lorry drivers blockade roads across Europe for shorter working hours.
-- Morgan Stanley investment bank publishes panel of 40 companies worlwide considered to have the best potential in terms of shareholders' value, only 10 of which are European.
-- Some unions call a strike of postal service Wednesday against reduction of labour force at La Poste.
